context: Request: deals the firm has done opposite Crescent Harbor Bank, N.A. (conflict / precedent check). Rubric: 1005-00001 (Nexford), 1021-00001 (Verimark), 1038-00002 (Cascade Retail), 1043-00001 (Ironhaven), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for the counterparty's name.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads three documents of the matter at the top of the listing and three emails from grep-hit matters (labelled as screening).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script over documents and emails printing passages around the name; times out after about 1M chars.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming four matters from the grep and scan output.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two greps for the name (one-level glob and .docx glob); both return nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads four documents of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A shell loop unzipping documents two folder levels deep prints nothing; a second loop over all files lists matches in several matters.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Shell grep over all emails for the name, with surrounding lines.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists one candidate matter's files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Lists two more candidates' files, then reads engagement letters, agreements and a closing memo of three candidates and one email of a fourth (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists a fourth candidate's files.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming four matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits a cited path, greps one matter for a date and reads a certificate to confirm it.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a glob of the empty output folder.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Shell grep -Ril with binary text over the store for the name; lists emails in four matters.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content-mode grep for the name plus reads of three emails from two candidates (labelled by the store-wide search).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Two batches of reads of long email threads (at offsets) and other emails across the four matters it settled on.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming four matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run

divergence: Shared procedure: a store-wide search for the counterparty name that reached email text (T0 the grep tool with a recursive glob, then an extraction scan; T1 a shell loop over all files after two empty greps; T2 grep -Ril on binary text) listed the same four matters, which each run confirmed from emails and agreements before naming all four.
